question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

The neighbouring army has _______ a war on us.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"declared"** means to announce something formally or officially. (घोषित करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The government **declared **a state of emergency after the flood.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word that fits the context of announcing a war formally is **"declared"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Gave **(दिया): Transferring possession of something to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She gave him a book as a gift.
 
 
 
• **Voiced **(व्यक्त किया): Expressing something in words.
 
 
• **Example: **He voiced his opinion during the meeting.
 
 
 
• **Said** (कहा): Uttering words to convey information.
 
 
• **Example:** She said she would be late.
